checks.title: Khong co gioi han kich thuoc file nao duoc ap dung o buoc lay presigned upload URL (CONFIRMED); TTL/scope cua URL van redact/chua xac nhan
checks.precondition: Da co presigned URL tu buoc 1 cua luong upload
steps: Request presigned upload URL cho 1 file 15MB (random bytes, dat ten.png)
Quan sat response POST /api/users/{userId}/temporary-files/upload-url
(Rieng) Kiem tra TTL cua presigned URL (thu dung lai URL sau 1 khoang thoi gian) va scope (bucket/prefix co gioi han theo user/store khong) - PHAN NAY VAN REDACT/CHUA XAC NHAN
checks.observation_point: Response POST upload-url cho file 15MB + (rieng) ket qua thu lai URL cu / kiem tra scope
checks.expected_result: CONFIRMED_EXPECTED cho phan gioi han kich thuoc (PO xac nhan 'thuc te thi chua co gioi han nao cho viec upload anh mockup', 2026-09-13 ): request presigned upload URL cho 1 file 15MB van tra 201 - KHONG co gioi han kich thuoc nao duoc ap dung o buoc nay. PHAN TTL va SCOPE (bucket/prefix) VAN REDACT theo redaction policy (contract §6) va CHUA duoc xac nhan qua kenh khac - KHONG duoc suy dien tu evidence da redact, giu nguyen la coverage_gap rieng (xem risk_refs). LUU Y (RECONCILE 2026-09-14): check nay la ve GIOI HAN KICH THUOC FILE, KHAC voi chu de NGUONG RESIZE (960/1000px, xem CHK-06-012 rieng) - khong lien quan CONF-CHK-06-005-001.
risk_refs: KB-050 security-surface-unverified MEDIUM (TTL/scope cua presigned URL van la coverage_gap, tach khoi phan gioi han kich thuoc da CONFIRMED)

Edit mo 'Mockup Editor' full-screen canvas that. Duplicate goi mutation thanh cong, TAO BAN GHI MOCKUP MOI THAT (id moi), COPY nguyen variant_ids tu ban goc. checks.title: [Tach tu CHK-06-005, cap nhat 2026-09-14] Nguong pixel thuc su kich hoat resize mockup: da loai tru <=1001px (999px va 1001px upload RIENG LE deu KHONG resize) qua 2 lan kiem chung doc lap; NGUONG THAT (neu co) VAN CHUA XAC DINH (CONF-CHK-06-005-001, UNRESOLVED)
checks.precondition: San sang upload nhieu file mockup voi chieu rong khac nhau (900/960/999/1000/1200px cho scenario cu; 999px/1001px rieng le cho scenario moi)
steps: Chon 5 file cung luc (900/960/999/1000/1200px chieu rong) de upload mockup (scenario lần khảo sát)
Quan sat so file thuc su duoc xu ly (endpoint upload-url ghi nhan bao nhieu request) va kich thuoc thuc te sau xu ly

RIENG LE (khong dong thoi, cach nhau >1 phut, doi xu ly xong han truoc khi upload tiep) upload 1 anh 999x999px va 1 anh 1001x1001px de loai bo hoan toan bien concurrency da phat hien o buoc tren (scenario lần khảo sát)

Doc lai kich thuoc qua 2 nguon doc lap: (a) field width/height cua GET /api/mockup-layers SAU KHI xu ly xong han; (b) tai truc tiep file _large.webp cong khai tren CDN va do pixel THAT bang lenh 'sips' (ngoai UI/API cua app)

(Buoc theo doi, CHUA THUC HIEN) Upload TUNG file rieng le tai pixel LON HON 1001px (vd 1500/2000/3000px) de tim nguong that su, hoac PO/dev xac nhan lai dieu kien resize co the khac pixel width/height don gian (DPI, dung luong file, ty le canh...)
checks.observation_point: So request upload-url thuc su duoc goi + kich thuoc file truoc/sau xu ly (ca 2 nguon doc lap o buoc rieng le)
checks.expected_result: Hien tai quan sat thay qua 2 lan kiem chung doc lap (OBSERVED_CURRENT, confidence HIGH cho ban than hanh vi 'khong resize'): (1) Ở lần kiểm thử đầu tiên: khi chọn 5 file cùng lúc (900/960/999/1000/1200px), CHI 3/5 file dau tien (900,960,999) thuc su duoc xu ly (goi y GIOI HAN CONCURRENCY ~3 khi chon nhieu file cung luc, 2 file con lai bi bo qua AM THAM khong loi/canh bao); ca 3 file GIU NGUYEN kich thuoc goc - 999px KHONG bi resize xuong 960, LOAI TRU gia thuyet nguong=960px. (2) Ở lần xác minh lại độc lập: upload RIENG LE (loai bo hoan toan bien concurrency), anh 999x999px (layer 4508) VA anh 1001x1001px (layer 4509) DEU KHONG bi resize - xac nhan qua 2 nguon doc lap (API mockup-layers SAU xu ly xong han + doc pixel THAT qua CDN/sips, ngoai UI/API cua app). Ket qua nay LOAI TRU TRUC TIEP CA gia thuyet nguong=960px (tu lần khảo sát truoc) VA gia thuyet nguong=1000px cua PO (PO tra loi lai 2026-09-14: 'nguong la 1000px', nhung ca 999px va 1001px rieng le DEU khong resize - MAU THUAN TRUC TIEP voi cau tra loi do). NGUONG THAT SU (neu co) VAN CHUA duoc xac dinh sau 2 lan kiem chung - CHUA co du lieu tai pixel LON HON 1001px. KHONG duoc khang dinh nguong cu the nao (960, 1000, hay bat ky gia tri nao) lam fact cho toi khi co evidence ro hon o pixel cao hon HOAC PO/dev xac nhan lai giai thich khac (khong phai pixel width/height don gian).
risk_refs: unresolved-threshold + oracle-risk MEDIUM (neu QA/dev mac dinh dung '1000px' lam nguong that de viet test oracle se SAI voi hanh vi da quan sat 2 lan)
silent-data-loss MEDIUM (gioi han concurrency ~3 file, phat hien o lần khảo sát truoc, lam nguoi dung tuong da upload nhung thuc te bi bo qua am tham)
